name: io.github.iamskeole/kokon-ee
title: Kokon EE
description: Generate and edit images offline with Qwen-Image 2.1 on your GPU, against the Kokon EE service (the box: docker image + browser UI). No API key, no cloud.

environmentVariables.name: QLS_MCP_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Extra folders the server may read and write, separated by semicolons. The project folder and Kokon's output folder are always allowed.
